sol_invictus.name: Sol Invictus
sol_invictus.purpose: Home automation, lighting, plugs, scenes & climate control

terminus.name: Terminus
terminus.purpose: Security surveillance, video intercom & intrusion defense

key_features_layout.persistent_header: Glassmorphic top bar with Sol Invictus / Terminus switcher pill, solar position widget (Dawn/Day/Sunset/Night status + lat/lon sun dial), active security alert status, quick settings launcher.

sections: Room & Zone Filter Pills (All, Living Room, Kitchen, Bedroom, Garden, Garage, + Add Room)
Quick Scene Activators (Movie Time, Relax, Morning Sun, All Off)
Grid of Transparent Bubble Cards representing devices (Light Dimmers with color spectrum pickers, Smart Plugs with power consumption gauges, Thermostats, Automations)
Unassigned / Newly Discovered HA Devices Banner & Drag-Assign Drawer
Anti-Intrusion Control Unit (Arm Away, Arm Stay, Disarm, Sensor Zone Matrix: Motion, Magnetic Contact, Glass Break)
Live Security Camera Feed Grid (4-view or single-expanded with AI motion detection badges & PTZ controls)
Intercom Doorbell Widget with Live Call Simulator, Audio Toggle & Remote Door Unlock CTA
Security Event Timeline Log (Timestamped activity feed)

key_features_layout.room_management_modal: Full CRUD for rooms/zones, room order re-ordering, entity moving tool.
key_features_layout.settings_modal: Home location settings (Address, Lat/Lon geocoding, Sun calculations), Dynamic solar colors toggle, Light/Dark override, HA Integration hub (Sonoff eWeLink, Tuya Smart Life, Tapo, Blink status).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the app uses JavaScript (.js files) as indicated by the workspace codebase structure.
Ensure no landing page exists: the default root route loads directly into Sol Invictus.
The header must feature an intuitive toggle between 'Sol Invictus' and 'Terminus' with distinct warm/cold active glowing pill styling.
Implement the Solar Position Engine hook or utility calculating the sun state (Dawn, Day, Sunset, Night) based on the user latitude/longitude and real system time.
Style device containers using transparent glass bubbles with backdrop blur (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/30 dark:bg-black/40 border border-white/20 rounded-3xl p-5 shadow-lg`).
Implement full Room CRUD functionality: create, edit name/icon, delete, and drag/move entities between rooms.
Include the newly detected HA unassigned devices bar with quick 'Assign to Room' dropdowns.
Include camera live stream mock feeds, intercom ring popup modal with door unlock button, and alarm zone status grid in Terminus.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive controls (buttons, toggles, sliders, inputs, navigation elements) to support automated testing.
Make sure hover states maintain contrast and all color switches are smooth (transition-colors duration-300).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use dark gradients; use flat or solid deep backgrounds combined with translucent glass overlays.
Avoid generic centered layouts; use generous asymmetrical grids and floating glass bubbles.
Ensure every interactive element has explicit hover/active states and clear text contrast.
Always include required test ids on buttons, switches, and form inputs (e.g. data-testid='switcher-sol-invictus', data-testid='alarm-arm-away').
